name: Kashmir
shortDescription: Illustrative destination profile for Kashmir — lakeside stays, mountain views, and slow travel moments for families and couples.
overview: Kashmir is an illustrative demo destination framed around Dal Lake, meadow drives, and cool mountain air. Travellers typically balance Srinagar’s lakeside pace with day trips to Gulmarg, Pahalgam, or Sonamarg — choosing seasons for gardens and mild weather, or for snow-focused scenery.
whyVisit: Lakeside stays and shikara moments on Dal Lake
Easy family-paced sightseeing with mountain backdrops
Seasonal contrast — spring gardens through winter snow scenes
Comfortable circuit options linking Srinagar, Gulmarg, and Pahalgam
Calm evenings suited to couples and multi-generational groups

bestTime: Illustrative: March–June for mild valley weather and gardens; July–August for lush greens (expect rain spells); December–February for snow-focused scenery — exact timing depends on travel style.
recommendedDuration: 5–7 days for a balanced Srinagar + Gulmarg + Pahalgam style circuit

name: Rajasthan
shortDescription: Illustrative destination profile for Rajasthan — heritage cities, desert landscapes, and cultural evenings.
overview: Rajasthan is presented in this demo as a heritage-forward circuit of forts, palaces, and desert evenings. Typical illustrative routes move through Jaipur and neighbouring cities at a culture-first pace.
whyVisit: Forts and palace architecture with strong photo moments
bestTime: Illustrative: October–March for cooler sightseeing days; summer months are hotter for outdoor circuits.
recommendedDuration: 6–8 days for a heritage-focused multi-city sample

name: Kerala
shortDescription: Illustrative destination profile for Kerala — houseboats, coastal towns, and tea-country drives.
overview: Kerala in this demo centres on backwater calm, coastal air, and unhurried sightseeing. Travellers often combine a houseboat or canal stretch with easy coastal or hillside time.
whyVisit: Relaxed pace suited to couples and families
Coastal towns and green inland drives
bestTime: Illustrative: October–March for comfortable sightseeing; monsoon months bring lush scenery with heavier rain.

name: Sikkim
shortDescription: Illustrative destination profile for Sikkim — mountain roads, quiet monasteries, and cool-climate escapes.
overview: Sikkim is included as an illustrative cool-climate mountain destination with monastery towns and scenic drives. Content here is lighter than Kashmir and meant to show template reuse.
whyVisit: Cool Himalayan air and mountain roads
Suitable for travellers who prefer elevated landscapes
bestTime: Illustrative: March–May and October–December for clearer mountain views; monsoon months may affect road comfort.
recommendedDuration: 5–6 days for a compact mountain escape
